old-behavior: module-import used plus + right-angle and accepted +⟩; source import used exact +> plus whitespace1; module-import-end always succeeded and extended a module identifier range
new-behavior: one import-sigil rule matches exact +>; module-import uses space-tab0; import-declaration uses space-tab1; module-import-end is removed; module identifier ranges end at the actual identifier
rationale: remove inconsistent sigil decomposition, accidental Unicode spelling, newline-after-sigil acceptance, and grammar-level range bookkeeping
